details.publicNotes:
Time warps are an innate defense mechanism of the timestream that can arise in the aftermath of excessive use of time magic or intrusion into the Dimension of Time. Lacking complex minds of their own, time warps instinctively attempt to stabilize the timestream to prevent any further damage or degradation. While time warps are actively aggressive to the perpetrators of the instability, excising these instabilities from the timeline, they can be equally dangerous to bystanders who've become swept up in the unstable region of time. Anyone caught within the maelstrom of temporal energies that a time warp produces is subjected to mental and physical distress as their minds struggle to handle the quick fluctuations in temporal perception and the entropic forces of accelerated aging and decay.

Temporal Tornadoes

Despite the fact that they are technically alive, time warps are natural forces, and you can no more reason with them than you can with tornadoes. Atemporal creatures, they can linger indefinitely in the eddies of uncontrolled time magic, and they're just as likely to sweep up long-future innocent travelers—or well-meaning chronomancers trying to put the world to rights—as they are to punish the authors of the original calamity.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 125/275/500 gp

Eligible Refinements perception item, skill items (Acrobatics)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, constitution, dexterity, elongating, energy resistant (acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, vitality, void), force, fortification, mind, mind shield, sensory (darkvision), throwing, time, wild, winged

description.value: When a time warp is targeted by or in the area of a spell that has the time trait or that grants the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3] conditions, it takes @Damage[5d8[force]] damage instead of the spell's normal effects. If the spell requires an attack roll, this vulnerability only applies if the attack roll hits.

The time warp decelerates time in area around it, slowing nearby creatures and causing them mental distress. Creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[6d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage and experience additional effects based on the results of a @Check[will|dc:29] save. The time warp can't use this ability again until it uses Accelerate Time.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage, and they are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target takes full damage, and they are also slowed 1 and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, and they are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

The time warp accelerates time in the area around it, quickening nearby creatures and subjecting them to entropic forces. Creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[6d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage and experience additional effects based on the results of a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save. Creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} from can only use the extra action to Stride or Strike. The time warp can't use this ability again until it uses Decelerate Time.

Critical Success The target takes no damage and is quickened for 1 round.

Success The target takes half damage and is quickened for 1 round.

Failure The target takes full damage and is quickened and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 round.

Requirements The time warp hits a target with a time lash Strike, and the target is affected by a magical effect that has the time trait or that grants the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3] condition

Effect The time warp attempts to remove the effect from that creature, rolling a counteract check against the effect (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]{+21}). If successful, the effect ends on the creature (but not any other affected creatures), and the creature takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage.
